name: Seminara MCP
description: Reviews and gates actions for Seminara's streamable HTTP MCP server (https://seminara.online/api/v1/mcp) that orchestrates live presentations, slides, and attendee lead capture. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep create_session on Review so an agent cannot provision new presentation sessions or consume account minutes without explicit confirmation.
Keep export_leads and submit_attendee_lead on Review so captured attendee contact information and PII cannot be exported or submitted without explicit user approval.
Keep pap_query_aura on Review so outbound attendee messages and conversation context require user review.
Use list_sessions, get_session, and get_session_analytics for read-only inspection of active presentations without modifying state or exposing attendee PII.
